purpose: Test whether the V20 failure is caused by voxel-level conditional location-scale heteroscedasticity rather than a global marginal mismatch.

single_change.name: voxel_level_conditional_affine_before_equal_source_gaussianization
single_change.feature: per-voxel corrected deterministic mean field m in y units, exactly the conditional_mean dataset produced by the frozen V14 mean-correction model
single_change.r_definition: the V14 standardized residual field in the frozen source cache, before V21 affine normalization
single_change.bin_edges: per-source training voxel quantiles pooled with source weight 1/3 each at q=0.0,0.1,...,1.0; float64 searchsorted right; bin index clamped to [0,9] at both ends
single_change.bin_center: equal-source weighted mean m within each bin
single_change.location: mu_bin = mean over the three per-source bin means
single_change.scale: sigma_bin = sqrt(mean over sources of E_source[(r-mu_bin)^2] within the bin)
single_change.interpolation: piecewise-linear float64 mu(m) and log_sigma(m) evaluated at frozen bin centers, constant extrapolation beyond endpoint centers, then float32 field application; apply minimum_scale to sigma_bin before log_sigma is formed
single_change.minimum_scale_binding_audit: record whether the floor binds in every source and split; any binding is not tuned after results
single_change.source_balance: normalize each source-bin moment separately, then average the three source moments
single_change.target: u=(r-mu(m))/sigma(m), then fit a new G21(u) using the byte-identical V20 equal-source train-only histogram/CDF recipe with 131072 bins, 8193 knots, z support [-5,5], and the same Addendum-A checks; subtract mean(G21(u)) per cube before Addendum-B projection
single_change.inverse: apply G21^-1 after the unchanged sampler DC centering, then r=u*sigma(m)+mu(m) before the unchanged V14 inverse
single_change.new_free_parameters: 2 predeclared hyperparameters (10 bins, minimum scale 0.25) plus 20 train-derived statistics (10 mu and 10 log_sigma values); derived statistics are not tunable parameters

inheritance.selection_role: smallest candidate step passing every unchanged field check in all three domains
inheritance.Q6: at step 10000, using frozen train-derived V21 m edges and equal-source per-domain reporting, generated/truth mean-delta-squared ratio and residual variance by deterministic-mean voxel decile; selection_role none
inheritance.Astrid: forbidden until development pass, committed seal, and explicit user approval

derived_artifacts: new V21 affine profile, refit G21 transform, six V21 caches, sigma_data and balanced band variances re-derived from V21 caches; no V20 numeric artifact is reused
hard_preflight: full pytest, train-only affine/profile audit, G21 Addendum-A roundtrip, per-cube centered Addendum-B audit, exact cache hashes, and unchanged evaluator/gate hashes
stop_rule: Apply the unchanged V20 fixed_decision_order: on development pass select the smallest passing candidate and stop before seal; on field-gate failure with Q3/Q4 pass classify conditional spatial limitation; on Q3 or Q4 failure classify conditional affine falsification. Every failure stops with Astrid and historical EAGLE unopened; no affine-bin, floor, architecture, or threshold rescue is allowed in the same run.
